title: Tennessee couple wins $57,200 after belongings vanish from storage units
description: Nathan and Devan Dickey experienced a devastating loss when their belongings disappeared from their rented storage units at Posey Storage Solutions. Despite Tim Posey’s assurances about security, the court found him liable for fraudulent misrepresentation and gross negligence. Ultimately, the Dickeys were awarded over $57,000 in damages, emphasizing the critical need for transparency and honesty in the storage industry to protect customer trust.

title: Deterring Russia becomes NATO's main effort as US scales back in Europe
description: NATO is considering a major shift in military planning due to heightened threats from Russia. Member states are discussing military capability requirements to focus either on European defense or global crisis management. Reports indicate a credible threat of conflict in Europe by 2030, prompting this reassessment. The Institute for the Study of War highlights coordinated Russian attacks against European nations.

title: Why Italy can’t switch off AC on a seized Russian billionaire’s $600 million yacht
description: Italy seized Sailing Yacht A, the $600 million superyacht owned by Russian billionaire Andrey Melnichenko, in Trieste in March 2022 under sanctions, and has been paying for its upkeep ever since. The upkeep reportedly costs about $30,000 a day, which covers a 20-person crew, fuel and climate control. The power can’t be switched off because the yacht holds paintings by Claude Monet and other artists that would deteriorate without stable temperature and humidity.

title: De Miguel’s family thank donors as fundraiser tops €217,000, Owono banned for 12 games
description: The family of Spanish footballer Jesús de Miguel have thanked supporters after a crowdfunding campaign raised €217,895 following his tragic death during Tenerife’s match against Andorra. Launched by Fran Sol, the appeal attracted thousands of donations from across football. Meanwhile, Andorra goalkeeper Jesús Owono has received a 12-match suspension for the fatal collision.

title: US flight chaos: Trump official seeks $50 billion for air traffic control
'We voted for her': Maithili Thakur faces villagers' ire as land dispute escalates
description: A land dispute has escalated in Darbhanga involving BJP MLA Maithili Thakur and her family. Villagers allege that portions of their private land are being encroached upon without resolution from the MLA. Political leader Vinod Mishra has criticized Maithili Thakur for not addressing the villagers' concerns adequately. Complaints have been submitted to various authorities seeking an impartial inquiry into these allegations.

title: Dragged, beaten with sticks, fists: J'khand woman killed over Rs 500 owed by dead man
description: Six individuals were arrested in connection with the murder of Jinggi Bankira in Hadimara village. The dispute arose over a debt of Rs 500 owed by Reena Gope's deceased husband. Following an altercation, Bankira was attacked by the accused, leading to her death from severe injuries. Evidence collected during the investigation included blood-stained items linked to the crime.

title: 26 years in UK, then letter sending Nigerian woman to India: Home office bizarre mix-up
description: A blind 67-year-old Nigerian woman named Comfort is on the brink of deportation after living in the UK for 26 years. Despite never setting foot in India, her plea for permanent residency was denied, suggesting she could receive care in either Nigeria or India. This case exposes flaws in the immigration process as the Home Office suggests new corrective measures, all while many migrants now endure extended delays.

title: Washington wife awarded $328,715 from ex-husband's 401(k), not cash
description: In a landmark ruling, a Washington court awarded a woman $328,715.53 from her husband's retirement funds. She raised concerns over tax consequences and financial liquidity, but the court upheld the arrangement, taking into account their financial situation and the duration of their marriage. Moreover, her requests for spousal support and legal fees were dismissed, a decision confirmed by the appellate court which maintained the original settlement.

title: PM Modi's convoy helicopter developed technical snag, remains stranded in Mysuru
Ukraine's Nato bid back on table, but at what cost? Zelenskyy on US Donbas question
description: Ukraine is exploring NATO membership, which could involve giving up the Donbas region for security guarantees. President Volodymyr Zelenskyy stated that US negotiators raised the issue during ongoing peace talks with Russia. Meanwhile, Ukraine is seeking additional military support and ammunition from European allies to enhance its defense capabilities against Russian aggression. Discussions include reinforcing air defense and energy infrastructure as winter approaches.

title: 'Can't completely surrender': Ex-cricketer criticises India after embarrassing loss
description: India suffered a significant batting collapse in the fourth ODI against New Zealand, leading to serious concerns. Head coach Gautam Gambhir and former opener Aakash Chopra emphasized the need for greater responsibility from the batters. New Zealand's Matt Henry took six wickets, dismantling India's top order effectively. This loss was India's second-heaviest in ODI history, highlighting ongoing issues within the batting lineup.

title: Magnitude 4 earthquake strikes Assam's Kamrup district
'Punjab da crorepati': Mann govt's big Gen Z push; launches 11-round quiz challenge
description: In a bid to engage the youth, Punjab chief minister Bhagwant Mann has launched 'Punjab Da Crorepati,' a quiz competition for individuals aged 15 to 30. With a grand prize of Rs 1 crore, participants will navigate through 11 rounds, including two live events hosted in 23 districts. Notably, 10,000 contestants stand to win additional prizes, while runners-up will each receive Rs 10 lakh.

title: Microsoft warns Outlook, Teams users against fake outage emails
description: Microsoft issued a warning about phishing attacks targeting Outlook and Teams users following a service disruption. Cybercriminals are impersonating official service health notifications to deceive recipients. Many phishing emails falsely claim that held emails will be deleted unless users restore them. Microsoft advises organizations to verify alerts through the admin centre and assess suspicious emails. Enhanced security measures should be implemented to protect against these phishing attempts.

title: ‘I’ll know straight away’: Wasim Akram questions Cummins’ Sandpapergate defence
description: Wasim Akram has expressed doubt regarding Pat Cummins' assertion of being unaware of the 2018 ball-tampering scandal. Akram states that a bowler with experience should be able to recognise the distinctive scratches made by sandpaper. Conversely, Cummins has firmly dismissed Usman Khawaja's allegations that the entire Australian squad was complicit.

title: ‘Bhool gaya’: Sooryavanshi’s hilarious response at toss on captaincy debut - Watch
description: Vaibhav Sooryavanshi made his captaincy debut for Bihar at just 15 years old. After winning the toss, he humorously forgot his team's playing XI moments later. Although he scored 18 runs, Bihar lost the match to Saurashtra by five wickets. Sooryavanshi has shown remarkable talent since making his India debut just five months ago. He will soon join India A for an upcoming tournament in Doha.

title: 'Discussions ended the day he left us': Sule breaks silence on NCP merger buzz
Mekedatu Dam row: Stalin seeks united TN stand, asks CM Vijay to call all-party meeting
description: MK Stalin has requested Chief Minister Joseph Vijay to hold an all-party meeting about the Mekedatu dam project. He emphasizes the importance of protecting Tamil Nadu's Cauvery water rights. Stalin believes that united political action is necessary to address this critical issue for farmers. Deputy Chief Minister DK Shivakumar asserts Karnataka's right to proceed with the dam construction.

title: Watch: Massive fire at Surat textile godown, thick smoke billows from site
description: A large fire erupted in a cloth storage godown located in the Kharvasa area of Surat. Fire tenders were immediately dispatched to the scene to combat the flames. Firefighting operations are currently in progress to control the situation. The cause of the fire remains undetermined at this time. Further information regarding the extent of damage is still awaited.

title: Portugal plan special Ronaldo tribute: Entire squad to wear No. 7 shirts
description: Portugal are preparing an emotional farewell to Cristiano Ronaldo following his international retirement after 23 years and 146 goals. Every squad member will reportedly wear his iconic No. 7 shirt before facing Denmark, while the match will pause in the seventh minute for supporters to applaud. The tributes will honour the country's most decorated footballer and his historic contribution to Portuguese football.

title: US B-21 stealth bomber drops first conventional weapon in landmark test
description: The B-21 Raider conducted its first conventional weapon-release test at Edwards Air Force Base. This achievement is pivotal for the US Air Force's next-generation stealth bomber program. The design focuses on integrating new weapons and validating operational capabilities for long-range strikes. The Air Force aims to acquire at least 100 B-21 aircraft to replace older bombers. These developments indicate the commitment to enhancing national defense strategies and capabilities.

title: 'Are we in kindergarten?': Ex-India player slams Cummins' sandpapergate explanation
description: The controversy resurfaced after Khawaja made several claims in his memoir, Sabr, suggesting that the entire Australian team, including current Test captain Cummins, knew about the plan to alter the condition of the ball.

title: Godhra train fire was deliberate, Sonia Gandhi's memoir claim is wrong: Ex-CBI officer
description: Rakesh Asthana, the former CBI special director, rebutted Sonia Gandhi's memoir regarding the Godhra train fire's cause. He emphasized that investigations confirmed the fire was deliberately set, supported by court verdicts. The Nanavati Commission and the Supreme Court-appointed SIT reinforced the findings of the Gujarat Police investigation. During the 2002 incident, 59 people died when a train was set on fire.

title: US assures India of tariff advantage over rival economies under proposed trade pact
'What my 40% tax gets': Gurgaon man shares dashcam footage of being chased on Diwali
description: A couple encountered a frightening situation when two men allegedly chased their car on Diwali night. The couple managed to reach their residential society’s entrance, where security personnel intervened. The other vehicle's occupants remained at the society gate for an extended period. Dashcam footage from the car and CCTV footage was shared on social media. Police have acknowledged the situation and initiated an investigation into the incident.

title: Watch: Passengers jump into water as luxury ship collides with tanker on Mississippi River
'My state, my right': DKS hits back at TN Cong over Mekedatu Dam row
description: Karnataka Chief Minister DK Shivakumar has stood firm on the Mekedatu Dam project, amidst objections from Tamil Nadu Congress president Manickam Tagore. He emphasized that the project is a right for Karnataka and dismissed the political backlash. To foster dialogue, Shivakumar encouraged Tamil Nadu officials to engage in conversations about the dam's advantages, reaffirming that Karnataka would respect the Supreme Court's ruling on water distribution.

title: Assam Class 9 student stabs mother with knife, writes about attack before jumping to death
description: On Friday night, a class nine student attacked his mother, injuring her seriously with a knife. The victim, Chandrani Kalita, is currently hospitalized in the Intensive Care Unit. Following the attack, the student jumped from a building, which resulted in his death. Police are investigating the incident but have not provided further details at this time. Updates will be shared as more information about the case becomes available.

title: 'Licence to kill' row: Child rights and inflation may fuel fresh protests across France
description: In France, protests are rapidly gaining momentum as diverse groups unite against new police legislation and economic challenges. Major participants include the influential Yellow Vest movement and various trade unions, with activists also spotlighting child safety and police violence. A controversial police bill, offering enhanced protections for officers, has further fueled these debates, especially with the 2027 presidential election looming, as far-right parties draw increasing scrutiny.

title: Suryakumar Yadav sends big message with 60 off 21 balls in SMAT
description: Chasing a target of 173, Suryakumar came in at No. 4 and struck six fours and five sixes to help Mumbai complete the chase in 13.1 overs.

title: How one network change disrupted Microsoft Outlook, Teams & AI tools that rely on them
description: Microsoft experienced a significant outage affecting Outlook, Teams, and other services for more than 24 hours. The incident, traced back to a network change, caused disruptions in email communication across various sectors. Companies around the world resorted to using faxes and phone calls as a temporary measure during the outage. Microsoft has confirmed that the issue was not a cyberattack or caused by AI.

title: Watch: Rahul Gandhi rides pillion with gig worker during Hyderabad rally
Jensen Huang's Nvidia exit cost him over Rs 900 crore: How much wealth does he have left?
description: Jensen Huang is expected to lose around $108 million in unvested stock awards following his exit from Nvidia. His net worth, primarily composed of Nvidia shares, is around $144.5 billion. Huang's holdings include approximately 812 million shares, valued at about $135 billion. Despite this wealth, he has sold around $3 billion in stock since Nvidia's IPO in 1999. Potential legal investigations may impact Huang's ability to sell shares in the future.

title: Elon Musk joins over 43,000 people asking Nvidia’s board to bring back Jensen Huang
description: Elon Musk has signed an open letter urging Nvidia’s board to reinstate Jensen Huang as CEO, joining more than 43,000 signers, including current and former Nvidia employees, shareholders and tech leaders like Tim Sweeney and Garry Tan. The letter demands an independent investigation, a fair hearing and a public explanation, days after Huang resigned over reported extramarital affairs, including one with an alleged Chinese spy, ending his 33-year run.
